title.narrative: PERFORMANCE-BASED PARTNERSHIP SCHEME FOCUSING ON QUALITY PROGRAMMING, UNDERSTANDING CHANGE AND RESULTS FOR POOR HOUSEHOLDS AND COMMUNITIES

description.narrative: The REGRADE-II programme will work in North and Central Gondar, Amhara State, Ethiopia. It aims to contribute to Concern Ethiopia’s Green Graduation thematic programme, and the goal of the grant is to ensure households can sustainably meet their basic needs and have improved coping strategies through strengthened livelihoods which place value on the natural environment. The programme will support over 38,470 people living in extreme poor households, female headed households, households with disabled members, landless, older people. This will be done through households receiving monthly income support to meet their basic consumption needs, households have access to basic services through regular coaching visits and referral linkage to services and target communities have improved knowledge and practice on (AMIYCN) adolescent, maternal, infant, young and child nutrition, hygiene and sanitation through coaching visits and health system strengthening.OBJECTIVES: Increased asset ownership, human capital through access to diversified livelihood optionsOUTCOMES: To improve the well-being of households living in conditions of extreme poverty residing in a community watershed through environmentally sustained and socially inclusive diversified livelihood activities
